text: {"lessons":["Selling winners repeatedly can leave me underinvested; I should decide whether to sell based on my target allocation and risk, not the comfort of realizing a gain.","I bought Stock A, C, D, and E after earlier sales, but those purchases are not automatically wise just because prices changed; I should assess each holding on its current merits.","I made no trades through several ups and downs, and the account moved both ways; patience can be appropriate, but I should review my overall exposure periodically rather than react to noise or neglect my plan."]}
